verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents first-party tool/function calling. It says agents can call APIs and take actions through OpenAI-compatible tool specifications, and it offers adjacent JSON-schema/grammar-constrained structured outputs. The evidence does not show the parallel, multi-step or faithful/reliable aspects the story emphasizes. Missing for 10: documentation of parallel tool calls, documentation of multi-step tool loops, evidence of tool-call accuracy or reliability on open models, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
